items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I received an awful lot of encouragement from the bands like Artie Shaw

ctx.x: Yeah. I couldn't figure out why he was there except for the fact that he might've been out there in the service.
But he didn't actually join the Navy Band which was directed by Artie Shaw until 1942. I looked that up. It's true his successful band was established in '46.
